# WildFly Admin Guide

> Server administration for WildFly — management interfaces, operating modes, subsystem configuration, domain setup, and operational tasks.

## Core Concepts

- [Target Audience](Target_Audience.adoc): Who this guide is for
- [Core Management Concepts](Core_management_concepts.adoc): Overview of the WildFly management layer, management model, and management interfaces
- [Operating Modes](Operating_modes.adoc): Standalone server vs. managed domain
- [General Configuration Concepts](General_configuration_concepts.adoc): Profiles, socket bindings, paths, system properties
- [Feature Stability Levels](Feature_stability_levels.adoc): Feature maturity classification — default, preview, community, experimental
- [Interfaces and Ports](Interfaces_and_ports.adoc): Network interface and socket binding configuration

## Management Clients

- [Management Clients](Management_Clients.adoc): Overview of CLI, web console, and programmatic management
- [Command Line Interface](Command_Line_Interface.adoc): Using the CLI (jboss-cli) for server management
- [CLI Recipes](CLI_Recipes.adoc): Common CLI commands and usage patterns

## Administrative Security

- [add-user Utility](add-user-utility.adoc): Creating management and application users
- [Role Based Access Control](RBAC.adoc): Configuring RBAC for management operations
- [Default HTTP Interface Security](Default_HTTP_Interface_Security.adoc): HTTP management interface security defaults
- [Default Native Interface Security](Default_Native_Interface_Security.adoc): Native management interface security defaults

## Deployment

- [Application Deployment](Application_deployment.adoc): Deploying applications via CLI, web console, filesystem scanner, and Maven plugin
- [Deployment Overlays](Deployment_Overlays.adoc): Overlaying content on existing deployments without repackaging
- [Management Resources](Management_resources.adoc): Management model resources for deployments

## Domain Setup

- [Domain Setup](Domain_Setup.adoc): Setting up and managing a WildFly managed domain

## Management API

- [Management API Reference](Management_API_reference.adoc): Overview of the management API
- [Description of the Management Model](management-api/Description_of_the_Management_Model.adoc): Structure and description of the management model tree
- [Detyped Management and jboss-dmr](management-api/Detyped_management_and_the_jboss-dmr_library.adoc): Using the detyped management model with the jboss-dmr library
- [Global Operations](management-api/Global_operations.adoc): Operations available on all management resources (read-resource, read-attribute, etc.)
- [The HTTP Management API](management-api/The_HTTP_management_API.adoc): RESTful HTTP management interface
- [The Native Management API](management-api/The_native_management_API.adoc): Native remoting-based management interface

## Management Tasks

- [Command Line Parameters](management-tasks/Command_line_parameters.adoc): Server startup arguments and system properties
- [JVM Settings](management-tasks/JVM_settings.adoc): Configuring JVM options for servers
- [Configuration File History](management-tasks/Configuration_file_history.adoc): Automatic snapshots and rollback of server configuration
- [Git Configuration File History](management-tasks/Configuration_file_git_history.adoc): Using Git to track configuration changes
- [YAML Configuration File](management-tasks/YAML_Configuration_file.adoc): YAML-based configuration overrides
- [Audit Logging](management-tasks/Audit_logging.adoc): Logging management operations for auditing

- [Canceling Management Operations](management-tasks/Canceling_Management_Operations.adoc): Canceling long-running management operations
- [Starting and Stopping Servers in a Managed Domain](management-tasks/Starting_and_Stopping_Servers_in_a_Managed_Domain.adoc): Managing server lifecycle in domain mode

- [Subsystem Configuration Overview](Subsystem_configuration.adoc): Introduction to subsystem configuration

- [Core Management Subsystem](subsystem-configuration/Core_Management.adoc): Core management subsystem configuration

- [DataSource Subsystem](subsystem-configuration/DataSource.adoc): JDBC datasource and connection pool configuration

### Web and REST

- [Undertow Subsystem](subsystem-configuration/Undertow.adoc): HTTP server, virtual hosts, servlets, websockets

- [Pooled Connection Factory to Remote Artemis](subsystem-configuration/Messaging_Connect_a_pooled-connection-factory_to_a_Remote_Artemis_Server.adoc): Connecting to a remote ActiveMQ Artemis server
